Gigi is a friendly, affectionate girl who loves being around people and happily seeks out attention. She enjoys pets and handling, approaches new people readily, and even engages in playful fun with her handler. With a medium energy level, Gigi enjoys exploring and following her nose on walks.

Gigi is still working on her leash manners and learning to keep all four paws on the ground when greeting people. She'll benefit from a little patience, structure, and positive reinforcement as she builds her skills. Her interactions with other dogs have been mixed, so slow, thoughtful introductions are recommended.

Gigi would do best in a home without children under 5, though older, dog-savvy kids may be a good fit. If you're looking for a loving, people-oriented companion to help blossom, Gigi could be your girl! ðŸ¾
